shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md app/ContactForm.tsx package.json && rg --files app && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/ContactForm.tsx tsconfig.json && git status --short && cat .gitignore'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

Path('tsconfig.json').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:tsconfig.json']))
shutil.rmtree('.next')
Path('next-env.d.ts').unlink()
PY

git diff --check && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import { writeFileSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
writeFileSync('tsconfig.json', execFileSync('git', ['show', 'HEAD:tsconfig.json']))
rmSync('.next', { recursive: true })
rmSync('next-env.d.ts')
NODE

git diff --check && git status --short"
